heading: Obstruction of a lawful hunt
lead: It is a violation of this section intentionally to engage in any physical conduct that significantly hinders a lawful hunt.

notes.text: Short TitlePub. L. 103–322, title XXXII, § 320801, Sept. 13, 1994, 108 Stat. 2121, provided that: “This subtitle [subtitle H (§§ 320801–320808) of title XXXII of Pub. L. 103–322, enacting this chapter] may be cited as the ‘Recreational Hunting Safety and Preservation Act of 1994’.”
